purpose: Official-source research contract for exact direct/ad-hoc pricing. Values that are ranges, minima, or maxima are deliberately not projected to individual stations/EVSEs.

verifiedDirectPricingGermany.note: The official Germany pricing page publishes exact direct prices for the 350 kW and 150 kW product bands, but only a 0.48-0.60 EUR/kWh range for the regular/50 kW band. The exact tariff is displayed before charging; the range must not be flattened or assigned by inference.

DEALL.neededToComplete: Resolve Allego's public station/QR tariff payload (or equivalent official station-level feed) so every DEALL station can be assigned its exact current direct price, especially the regular/<=50 kW stations whose official national page only exposes a price range. Do not infer the exact value from power alone without a documented Allego mapping.

verifiedGermanyPricing.note: IONITY explicitly states that its website values are current minimum prices and the station price can be higher. Its July 2026 pricing explanation states that Germany direct/ad-hoc pricing is up to 0.76 EUR/kWh and that the applicable price is shown in the app or on the charger. Therefore 0.72 EUR/kWh must not be applied network-wide.

publicDirectFlow.chargerSelection: Official support confirms that the charger can be selected manually on the payment website or opened from the charger QR code.

DEIOY.neededToComplete: Discover a stable public station/EVSE identifier-to-price contract in payment.ionity.eu or another official station feed, then capture the applicable direct tariff for every DEIOY EVSE. The national minimum/maximum values are not sufficient for exact station-level assignment.
